Independent review of run r-20260929T081404104870-srw-receipts-help-names-its-default at head 0bf0b6031182cb26dc4670224e82b1cb9df2fbde against base 7f36237a62e352f27beda581198ea57daa8ae882. The node repairs the same class of defect the plan records for the watch command, at the receipts writer: the agent receipts --output help named ~/.local/share/ambix/receipts and the command itself wrote there, while the recorder that slurm launches and the watch reader both resolve the site's receipts directory through imas_ambix.agent.watch.default_record_dir, so the same serve's record could be defective.

Goal fidelity. The --output help now reads 'Receipts file path (default: the site's receipts directory, resolved by watch.default_record_dir through the site configuration, under <slug>.jsonl).' and the command's own default now reads 'receipts_path = default_record_dir() / f"{name}.jsonl"'. Both halves were verified at the reviewed head, not read: the help was rendered through click's CliRunner, and with AMBIX_AGENT_BASE_DIR pointed at a temporary base the command handed the recorder /tmp/receipts-default-check/agents/receipts/deepseek-v4-flash.jsonl while its help named the same resolution. The default follows the environment rather than a frozen constant, which is the property the whole repair exists to restore.

Independent verification. The declared gate was re-run at 0bf0b6031182cb26dc4670224e82b1cb9df2fbde under the shared project interpreter with module.__file__ named inside the reviewed worktree: tests/test_agent_watch_help.py 5 passed; tests/test_agent_serve_registry.py -k agent_package_modules_parse_with_serving_python 1 passed 8 deselected; ruff check imas_ambix tests All checks passed. The reviewed node's own negative-control log opens with the declared string verbatim and shows both new receipts tests failing on the restored stale string. Against the base revision the reviewed tests fail for that same reason (2 failed, 3 passed) with the base blob quoted.

Write scope. git diff --name-status base..head carries exactly three paths: imas_ambix/agent/cli.py, tests/test_agent_watch_help.py, and the four-line evidence fragment; no plan-version or plan-modified meta line moved, the declared figures directory was never created, and the worktree reads clean at the reviewed head and after this review's read-only runs.

Residual gaps. Nothing pins the writer's use of the helper: the help text and the helper's value are both asserted, so reverting the writer to Path.home() while leaving the help green keeps all five tests passing, which is exactly the drift this repair exists to prevent. The help names a Python symbol where a user looks for a setting; the actionable knob is the environment-backed site base. The fragment is committed without a trailing newline, and the docstring above default_record_dir still describes the two sides agreeing without a shared function, which the change superseded.
